sonnet.problem: The opening card says the Sadducees are a group 'who say there is no resurrection'. This points straight at the correct answer to card 2, which asks what has the leaders so upset (they proclaim the resurrection in Jesus). The card also sets up the wrong answers (offerings, Sabbath) as unlikely.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asked whether many who heard the message believe (Acts 4:4). Card 5 asks about the same verse and restates 'Many who heard the message believe' in its question. Both cards make the same point, so they should be one question.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question.
